column1: # Vietnamese brand names: how Vietnamese speakers say them.
# One entry per line: <brand><TAB><reading>. Lines starting with "#" and blank
# lines are ignored. Matching ignores letter case ("MoMo", "Momo", "MOMO") and
# treats any run of spaces in a brand as one space ("Zalo Pay", "Zalo  Pay").
# The longest brand wins, so "zalo pay" beats "zalo".
# List only brands the pipeline reads WRONG without an entry. English names
# that G2P already handles (iPhone, YouTube, Spotify) stay out. Write the
# reading in Vietnamese spelling; "d" is /z/ in this G2P, so "da lô" gives zaː lo.
# English words inside a reading ("pay", "bank") are left plain, and G2P picks
# Every entry needs a case in tests/python/test_normalize.py.
# "vyn", not "vin": beside Vietnamese words G2P reads "vin" as Vietnamese
# Banks. The embedded acronym would otherwise hit the abbreviation table
# ("BV" -> "bệnh viện", "TP" -> "thành phố") or be spelled letter by letter.
